title: Zrínyi Miklós: Adriai tengernek syrénája (parallel source edition of the Syrena codex and the 1651 print)
institution: ELTE BTK Régi Magyar Irodalomtörténeti Tanszék (Gépeskönyv series); edited by Orlovszky Géza, Budapest 1998
author: Zrínyi Miklós
region: Kingdom of Hungary; printed in Vienna
notes: Parallel edition (published 1998 in the Gépeskönyv series of the Old Hungarian Literature Department, ELTE) of Miklós Zrínyi's epic cycle 'Adriai tengernek syrénája': the text of the so-called Syrena manuscript beside the 1651 Vienna print (printed by Kosmerovi Máte), with the idylls, the 15 parts of the Obsidio Szigetiana, and the shorter poems. Both witnesses are old-spelling transcriptions in plain HTML pages. Counts are ours: 2 texts and about 92,000 words, counted from the 22 pages of the manuscript text and the 21 pages of the print text (letter-only tokens, page and folio marks left out). The site's files date from 2006 and show no later change, so it is listed as archived. The text opens in a frameset; the page at this address links to it.
